notes: Adapter manifest for the Lom reference implementation (ACRI v0.1 L1 surface).
All relative paths resolve against the conformance/ directory of this repository.
Command templates are argument arrays: {bin} = binary, {file} = probe file path, {code} = diagnostic code.
The suite drives the toolchain only through these templates at the process boundary (specification section 0 neutrality).

enum_normalization.registered: implementations/lom.md: section 1.2 suggestion enums match after documented case normalization (e.g. High -> high)

position_zero_sentinel.registered: implementations/lom.md: anchor "none" with an honest 0:0 for the positionless input-unreadable channel (LEX000) — the shape the v0.2-draft erratum legitimizes

unreadable_input.note: by definition absent — the input-unreadable channel (rc >= 2)
